End users have limited OAuth configuration possibilities. Here is a Microsoft Exchange example.

= Custom TenantID and AppID for Microsoft Exchange =

When creating an Exchange account in Thunderbird, end users can override their TenantID and AppID as follows:

# Create your Exchange Account as normal on first run  or Thunderbird app menu {menu ☰} > {menu Add Account} > {menu Email}
# Set up  your custom configuration: Thunderbird app menu {menu ☰} > {menu Account Settings} underneath your account e.g. nemo@o365.thunderbird.net > {menu Advanced…}
# Check '''Override Office365 Settings''' and add your Tenant ID and AppId and click {button OK}

See [[Custom OAuth for Thunderbird]] for the other ways to customize OAuth2 in Thunderbird.
